item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Indian government bonds decreased in early trading due to rising oil prices and cautious investor sentiment. The benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield increased significantly amid higher expectations for a rate hike. New Delhi is set to raise 330 billion rupees through a bond sale, contributing to market tension.

item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Indian government bonds experienced a decline this week, largely influenced by rising oil prices and US Treasury yields. Analysts are anticipating a potential increase in interest rates from the Reserve Bank of India in their upcoming policy decision.

WHY IT MATTERS

item.title: [6.4] Reading, Not Adapting: Unlocking Frozen Visual Knowledge for AI-Generated Image Detection
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Generalization to unseen image generators has driven efforts to adapt pretrained visual representations for detection. Yet recent findings show that vision foundation models already encode transferable detection knowledge, while further adaptation can impair generalization. This motivates a shift from backbone adaptation to knowledge readout.

WHY IT MATTERS

This paper presents a solid methodological shift for AI-generated image detection by prioritizing knowledge readout over backbone adaptation, though it remains an incremental research contribution.

item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Agent-orchestrated robot systems combine the general reasoning capability of multimodal agents with the precise physical control of learned visuomotor policies. Yet such systems often fail at the moment of handoff: a policy is reliable only from a limited set of start states, while the agent may invoke it outside this region. We call this region the policy's handoff boundary.
